name: Jelucan
description: Jelucan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. During the Age of the Empire, Jelucan was annexed by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of Thane Kyrell and Ciena Ree, two star-crossed lovers who fought on opposite sides of the Galactic Civil War.
